IOT DEEP MASTER CORPUS — 1000 EXAMPLES
======================================

A large IoT engineering corpus based on the supplied curriculum. It spans
physical electronics, microcontrollers, sensors/actuators, embedded buses,
MQTT/CoAP/HTTP, Wi-Fi/BLE/LoRaWAN/Zigbee/Thread/cellular concepts, ESP32,
STM32/FreeRTOS concepts, edge gateways, industrial IoT, Modbus/OPC UA,
time-series data, TinyML, device security, secure boot, PKI, OTA updates,
Linux edge systems, mobile IoT clients, testing, operations, and end-to-end
case studies.

EXACT TOTAL: 1000 examples.

Distribution:
Arduino C++ 180 | Embedded C 150 | C++/ESP32 120 | MicroPython 120 |
Python IoT Backend 120 | JavaScript/Node.js 70 | Kotlin/Android IoT 40 |
SQL/Time-Series 40 | YAML/JSON/Config 30 | Bash/Linux Edge 30 |
Pseudo-code/Architecture 100

Each example includes a compact implementation, case study, engineering
analysis, failure modes, and a production task. Vendor-specific APIs should
always be checked against the target board, SDK and protocol documentation.


================================================================================================
ARDUINO C++ — 180 EXAMPLES
================================================================================================

EXAMPLE 0001 | Arduino C++ | GPIO and digital I/O
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
CONCEPT
GPIO and digital I/O in an IoT device → gateway → cloud/edge workflow.

CODE / CONFIGURATION
```text
const int SENSOR=A0, ACTUATOR=8;
void setup(){ Serial.begin(115200); pinMode(ACTUATOR,OUTPUT); }
void loop(){ int raw=analogRead(SENSOR); bool alarm=raw>501;
digitalWrite(ACTUATOR,alarm?HIGH:LOW); Serial.println(raw); delay(1000); }
```

CASE STUDY
A cold-chain logistics deployment can use this pattern to collect or act on device state. The system should continue safely during network loss and expose health telemetry separately from ordinary measurements.

ENGINEERING ANALYSIS
Study the physical constraints, firmware representation, communication
behavior, storage/processing layer, and security boundary. Determine what
happens under invalid readings, power loss, packet loss, duplicate messages,
reordering, stale timestamps, clock drift, memory exhaustion and restart.

FAILURE / EDGE CASES
• sensor disconnected or out of range
• network unavailable
• duplicate or delayed packet
• corrupted configuration
• low battery
• watchdog/reset
• unavailable cloud/broker
• unsafe actuator state

PRODUCTION TASK
Add bounded memory use, validation, retry/backoff, structured logging,
health telemetry, safe defaults, tests, observability and appropriate
authentication/integrity controls.

CROSS-LAYER TASK
Trace one physical event through sensor → firmware → bus → network →
gateway → broker/API → storage → analytics → dashboard/actuator.

LEARNING CHECK
Explain which processing should remain local when the cloud is unavailable,
and identify the most important failure boundary for this example.

```text
reading={"device_id":"device-050","temperature_c":25.0,"seq":650}
window.append(reading["temperature_c"])
print(json.dumps(reading),sum(window)/len(window))
```

CASE STUDY

ENGINEERING ANALYSIS
Study the physical constraints, firmware representation, communication
behavior, storage/processing layer, and security boundary. Determine what
happens under invalid readings, power loss, packet loss, duplicate messages,
reordering, stale timestamps, clock drift, memory exhaustion and restart.

FAILURE / EDGE CASES
• sensor disconnected or out of range
• network unavailable
• duplicate or delayed packet
• corrupted configuration
• low battery
• watchdog/reset
• unavailable cloud/broker
• unsafe actuator state

PRODUCTION TASK
Add bounded memory use, validation, retry/backoff, structured logging,
health telemetry, safe defaults, tests, observability and appropriate
authentication/integrity controls.

CROSS-LAYER TASK
Trace one physical event through sensor → firmware → bus → network →
gateway → broker/API → storage → analytics → dashboard/actuator.

happens under invalid readings, power loss, packet loss, duplicate messages,

• sensor disconnected or out of range
• network unavailable
• duplicate or delayed packet
• corrupted configuration
• low battery
• watchdog/reset
• unavailable cloud/broker
• unsafe actuator state

authentication/integrity controls.

PRODUCTION TASK
Add bounded memory use, validation, retry/backoff, structured logging,
health telemetry, safe defaults, tests, observability and appropriate
authentication/integrity controls.

CROSS-LAYER TASK
Trace one physical event through sensor → firmware → bus → network →
gateway → broker/API → storage → analytics → dashboard/actuator.

LEARNING CHECK
Explain which processing should remain local when the cloud is unavailable,
and identify the most important failure boundary for this example.

FOR EVERY PROJECT STUDY
=======================
• hardware/BOM and electrical constraints
• GPIO/I2C/SPI/UART/RS-485 map
• sampling strategy and calibration
• power budget and sleep strategy
• firmware state machine
• telemetry schema
• MQTT/topic or HTTP API design
• offline/store-and-forward behavior
• device identity and key management
• threat model
• OTA/recovery strategy
• unit/integration/HIL testing
• metrics, logs and alerts
• deployment architecture
• failure-mode analysis
• scalability and cost
